module: Node "Line Point From Xnorm" (repeat_instant). Returns the position located between two points of a line according to a ratio xnorm (0 = posA, 1 = posB; 0.5 by default if not provided). Inputs: posA, posB (vec3), xnorm. Output: pos (vec3 as a table).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: If posA and posB are connected, calls the global function linePointFromXnorm and writes the result to pos.
